svg.aria-label: Fees go to Payers. A Receiver pool of 10,000 dollars trades 200,000 dollars a year, ten round trips in and out. At 0.1 percent each way, each round trip pays 20 dollars to the Payer pool, 200 dollars a year. Over a year, 5,000 dollars of Payers backing those Receivers at 5 percent earn 250 dollars of their own interest, 500 dollars of the Receivers' interest and 200 dollars of fees, about 950 dollars or 19 percent.
svg.title: Fees go to Payers
